summary: Asked to close a supplementary card; closure confirmation not received.
Re-KYC documents submitted twice; account still shows as restricted.
Email from the customer's office: property documents not returned three weeks after the loan was closed.
Disputed a foreign merchant charge; no update since the dispute was raised.
UPI payment debited but failed; reversal not received after the T+1 timeline.
Email from the customer's assistant: an insurance policy was added to the account without a clear explanation.
Complaint about a closed service request that was not resolved; names the RBI Ombudsman as the next step.
Reward points on travel spends lower than expected after the cap change.
RM called back and logged a fresh request; resolution promised within two working days.
Asked why the card was moved to a new variant without consent; says fees now apply.
Automated call read out the decline reason. The customer asked for a limit change; the bot could not make it.
Email from the customer's assistant, on their behalf: the card was declined twice abroad; please raise the limit tonight. Linked through the bank's own contact records.
Visited the branch about the car-loan EMI date; mentioned the open card dispute.
Called the accounts helpline to move funds for the same payment; asked why no one had called back about the card.
Public reply to the bank's care handle: two days, three contacts, still no answer. Linked through a verified contact the bank already holds.
Questioned a foreclosure charge on a personal loan that was not in the sanction letter.
Repeat call: limit raised for 48 hours; the agent promised a callback on the declines. No callback logged.
Reported two card transactions the customer did not make; card blocked, shadow credit pending.
App blocked on a new phone with a security alert; cannot approve a large transfer.
